eli5: A secret password that lets an app use someone else's service, like a library card for a robot.
english: A private code that proves you're allowed to use an online service. Whoever has it can use your account, so it stays secret.
dev: Bearer credential sent with each request to authenticate and bill calls to a provider's API.

eli5: A free ticket that lets the helper use a faster clever computer.
english: A private code from Google or Groq that lets BlankStare use their free AI on your behalf. Optional; BlankStare works without one.
dev: Provider API key (Gemini or Groq), stored in chrome.storage.sync and sent only to that provider.

eli5: A little window that sits at the side of your browser.
english: Chrome's panel at the right edge of the window, which stays open beside the page you are reading.
dev: chrome.sidePanel surface (MV3), opened from a user gesture.

eli5: A window where you type instructions to your computer instead of clicking.
english: The app where you type commands, such as Terminal on a Mac or PowerShell on Windows.

eli5: The "read me first" note that comes with a program.
english: The front page of a software project, explaining what it is and how to install it.

eli5: The clever computer brain that writes the answer.
english: One particular AI that writes answers. Different companies offer different models; BlankStare picks a working free one each day.
dev: LLM identifier at a provider, e.g. gemini-3.8-live or Qwen3.8-27B; ranked daily from The Nein plus the provider catalogue.

eli5: A checker that looks every day at which clever computers are free.
english: A daily list, made by BlankStare's author, of AI models that are free and actually working today.
dev: Public JSON at stravelakis.com/wp-json/nein/v1/models.json with free status, lifecycle and test status per model.

eli5: A company in Europe that lends its clever computer for free, no ticket needed.
english: A European cloud company whose AI service answers BlankStare's questions when you have no key. Free, slower when busy.
dev: OVHcloud AI Endpoints, anonymous OpenAI-compatible lane, about 2 requests per minute per model per IP.

eli5: A company with very fast clever computers. You need a free ticket from them.
english: An AI company known for very fast answers. A free key from console.groq.com makes it available in BlankStare.
dev: OpenAI-compatible API at api.groq.com; also hosts the Orpheus TTS model.

eli5: Google's clever computer. With a free ticket it can also talk.
english: Google's AI. A free key from Google AI Studio gives BlankStare its best answers, read aloud in Gemini's own voice.
dev: Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com), streamGenerateContent plus the Live BidiGenerateContent WebSocket.
